candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - where to view and download metadata for all LiDAR products
verified_facts: EA states its LiDAR holdings in this catalogue are for England.
EA directs users to metadata and coverage maps for the LiDAR Capture Programme.
EA states that if no data is listed for a location, that location has not been surveyed in the catalogue to date.
semantic_limits: Missing catalogue coverage must be treated as NO_DATA for that source/location, never filled with an inferred or fabricated elevation.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey data download - data formats available
verified_facts: EA states LiDAR raster data is available in GeoTIFF format.
National LiDAR Programme and LiDAR Composite raster data is supplied in 5km tiles.
LiDAR point-cloud data is available as LAZ, the compressed form of LAS.
semantic_limits: A LAZ/LAS point cloud and a GeoTIFF raster are different representations; raw point returns cannot silently replace the processed DTM raster used by the measured parcel result.
